ref: ADR-0005: sqrt is computed in xs:double and cast back to xs:decimal (the catalogue deviation)
note: Qty is 2 and 0.0001. The root is the double nearest to it, written as the xs:decimal that double equals exactly, so 0.0001 gives 0.01000000000000000020816681711721685132943093776702880859375, not 0.01. That is the deviation the catalogue states.
